findings.identity_explanation: COM-04 uses tag FCU-507 with model CF-12 and 'Level 5 east wing', serial not recorded. The tag format suggests FCU-L5-07 but the location matches FCU-L5-08 (CR:FCU-L5-08 'Level 5 east wing'; CR:FCU-L5-07 is 'Level 5 west wing'). Model agrees with both units and the serial is unknown, so fewer than two attributes agree without conflict (Matching 2.2, 3.1). COR-02 confirms the contractor does not know which unit the FCU-507 sheet covers. Records not merged.

exceptions.finding: The only commissioning certificate listing the exact tag FCU-L5-07 (COM-12) has Final approval: Not signed, is a draft, records no serial, and says it is to be re-issued. Wing is also not recorded.

evidence.quote: Result: Pass | Final approval: Not signed
Draft sheet. Unit tested but wing not recorded. To be re-issued.

exceptions.responsible_party: Brisel MEP Services (installing subcontractor), through Halvorn Contracting
exceptions.next_action: Re-issue COM-12 with signed final approval, serial and wing recorded. A promise of re-issue is not the document (Evidence 2.3).

exceptions.finding: COM-04 (signed, Pass) uses tag FCU-507. Tag suggests FCU-L5-07 but location 'Level 5 east wing' matches FCU-L5-08; serial not recorded. Cannot be linked to either unit. Contractor says it will check after handover.

exceptions.responsible_party: Halvorn Contracting (main contractor) with Brisel MEP Services
exceptions.next_action: Verify on site which unit was tested under tag FCU-507 and its serial, before handover on 24 Nov 2026, and reissue the sheet with the correct tag.

findings.summary: FCU-L5-07 is not ready for acceptance: its own commissioning certificate COM-12 is an unsigned draft (critical). A second signed certificate, COM-04, uses tag FCU-507 with an east wing location and cannot be linked to FCU-L5-07 or FCU-L5-08, so the match is uncertain and escalated. Warranty, O&M manual, FM record, PPM plan and register identity all pass.
findings.escalation_reason: Asset match is uncertain (Escalation 2.2, Matching 3.1): COM-04 tag FCU-507 points to FCU-L5-07 but its location points to FCU-L5-08, and no serial is recorded. The manager must decide whether to request an on-site verification from Halvorn before handover and how to treat COM-04 meanwhile.
findings.clarification_to: Halvorn Contracting project manager (for Brisel MEP Services)
findings.clarification_subject: Sarava Tower - FCU-L5-07 / FCU-L5-08: commissioning sheets COM-04 and COM-12
findings.clarification_body: Please (1) verify on site, before the 24 November 2026 handover, which fan coil unit was tested under the old tag FCU-507 on COM-04 (west wing FCU-L5-07 or east wing FCU-L5-08), recording its serial number from the unit plate; (2) re-issue COM-04 with the correct current tag; and (3) re-issue COM-12 for FCU-L5-07 with final approval signed, the serial and the wing recorded. Please do not send a promise to follow in place of the signed documents.
uncertainties: Which unit COM-04 (FCU-507) actually covers is unknown.
Serial numbers are not recorded on COM-04 or COM-12.
Whether the test on COM-12 was of the west wing unit is not stated; wing not recorded.
